description: This file defines the ReadableShopOrder class, which extends ReadableOrder, representing an order with additional details such as shipping summary, subtotal details, grand total, and error message. It is a data transfer object (DTO) used in the web layer of the application.

classes.name: ReadableShopOrder
classes.description: A serializable Java class extending ReadableOrder, representing a detailed view of a shop order including totals, shipping summary, and error messages.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the global error message associated with the order, if any.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets the global error message associated with the order.

methods.name: getGrandTotal
methods.description: Returns the grand total amount for the order.

methods.name: setGrandTotal
methods.description: Sets the grand total amount for the order.

methods.name: getSubTotals
methods.description: Returns the list of subtotal details for the order.

methods.name: setSubTotals
methods.description: Sets the list of subtotal details for the order.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Returns the shipping summary details for the order.

methods.name: setShippingSummary
methods.description: Sets the shipping summary details for the order.
